About the Monday Night Meander group ride

A casual 15–20 mile Monday evening ride in the West Valley. The group's motto is 'nobody gets left behind.' Any bike and any fitness level. The same group also runs a Wednesday sunrise ride and a Thursday night ride.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
